gbm_population_evidence.quote: Previously confirmed (histologically or cytologically) high grade glioma that is clinically or radiographically suspected to be relapsed, refractory, or recurrent

candidate_evidence.quote: CLR 131 will be administered IV (intravenously) at a dose based on patients' BSA

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Previously confirmed (histologically or cytologically) high grade glioma that is clinically or radiographically suspected to be relapsed, refractory, or recurrent

role_evidence.quote: Two dosing cohorts will be explored; patients in the first arm will receive two doses, 20 mCi/m2 each, separated by 14 days for two cycles

agents.drug_class_hint: iodine-131 labelled phospholipid ether radiopharmaceutical (iopofosine I 131)

coder_notes: Paediatric/young adult (10-25 y) high-grade glioma with no glioblastoma named, so S5 fails (high_grade_glioma_unspecified). stdAges include ADULT. Tumour uptake by SPECT/dosimetry is imaging of the radiopharmaceutical itself, not coded as tumour PK or target engagement.
